title: Technical Product Manager
desc:
Technical Product Manager
Location
: Istanbul (Bakırköy) / On-site
Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas, Sixfab develops industrial-grade edge computing and cellular connectivity solutions built on the Raspberry Pi ecosystem. With its ALPON X5 AI product, Sixfab was honored with the
CES 2026 Best of Innovation in Enterprise Tech award,
a milestone that highlights the power of AI + IoT and showcases how Sixfab continues to connect intelligence with the physical world. As a Raspberry Pi Design Partner since 2021 and a DEEPX Partner for on-device AI, we bring this vision to life with the best in the ecosystem.
Now, we are growing fast and expanding our team. If you’re excited about shaping the future of Physical AI and edge computing technologies that bring intelligence into the real world, we’d love to hear from you.
﻿Qualifications
BSc or MSc in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Computer, Mechatronics Engineering or a related field.
8+ years of experience in embedded hardware/product development, including technical leadership of multidisciplinary programs.
Proven track record of taking embedded products from concept through prototype, certification and volume production.
Experience presenting products and technical designs to international customers in live meetings and securing their approval.
Experience in a product management, technical product owner or customer-facing solutions engineering role, including requirements definition and technical proposals.
Strong knowledge of SBCs, compute modules and edge computing architectures, with hands-on understanding of common hardware interfaces (PCIe, USB, Ethernet, CAN, RS-485, etc.) and wireless connectivity (LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GNSS).
Ability to review schematics, PCB layouts, power and thermal designs.
Ability to translate customer problems into product requirements and make clear technical and business trade-offs.
Fluent in English and Turkish, with excellent presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
Responsibilities
In this role, you will own custom edge computing products end to end, from strategy and definition to technical architecture, customer solutions and the full product lifecycle through volume production.
Drive the technical definition and delivery of custom carrier boards, gateways and complete edge AI computers built for professional customers, from concept to volume production.
Act as the technical product owner between customers, sales, engineering and manufacturing.
Confidently run live meetings with customers and partners in the US and Europe: present new products and architecture and design reviews to customer engineering teams, discuss technical requirements and secure technical approval.
Own the product definition for Custom Design programs, translating customer and market needs into clear requirements, specifications, priorities and success criteria.
Develop and maintain product roadmaps, and identify opportunities to standardize and reuse Sixfab reference designs, platforms and software components.
Analyze competitive products, BOM costs, component availability and market trends to guide platform and architecture decisions.
Prioritize engineering work based on customer value, business impact and technical risk.
Work with the Director of Industrial Computing Solutions to evaluate business cases, development costs, production volumes and target margins.
Establish engineering standards for design reviews, documentation, release management and testing.
Define system architecture for custom edge computers, covering compute, connectivity and AI acceleration, and evaluate compute platforms based on performance, cost, availability and customer requirements.
Drive hardware, BSP and software design reviews, and document key technical decisions and trade-offs.
Own the embedded Linux stack per product, from bootloader and drivers to OTA updates and security.
Run technical discovery and feasibility reviews, convert customer requirements into product specifications and engineering work packages, and propose alternatives that improve cost, performance or time-to-market.
Write the technical sections of RFP and RFQ responses.
Plan and run prototype builds, hardware bring-up and testing, and drive certification readiness (CE/RED, FCC, PTCRB and others as applicable).
Work with manufacturing on DFM/DFT and production test to ensure a smooth transition to volume production.
Own root-cause analysis for field issues and RMAs, and use field and production feedback to drive engineering changes, obsolescence management, cost-down initiatives and improvements to requirements and reusable platforms.
What We Offer
Continuous learning, training and professional development opportunities in a collaborative, high-energy, fast-growing workplace where every contribution counts and ownership is encouraged
Ownership of the product and engineering decisions behind real products shipping to US and European customers
The chance to work hands-on with the latest edge computing and AI technologies and platforms
The opportunity to work on international projects with global impact
An annual training budget to support your learning and development
A supportive benefits package that includes transportation, meal allowance and health insurance that also covers your family, along with various employee benefits throughout the year.
